name: codex_quota
description: Fetch current remaining Codex usage quota from the signed-in account: remaining percentages, window lengths and UTC reset times for every reported limit bucket. Queries Codex's account/rateLimits/read without a model call. Does not return money or estimate remaining tokens. Missing windows are unknown, not unlimited. Authentication and network errors are returned directly.

working_dir.description: Absolute directory whose Codex configuration to use. Defaults to this server's directory.
